title: School Purpose and Learning Approach
content: The online Tamil school helps students build confidence in listening, speaking, reading, and writing Tamil. Classes use live instruction, guided practice, stories, songs, conversation, and age-appropriate cultural activities. Teachers encourage respectful participation and steady practice at home.

title: Enrollment and Placement
content: A parent or guardian completes the registration form for each student. New learners are placed through a short assessment, trial class, or discussion with the teacher. Placement considers the student's age, previous Tamil learning, speaking ability, reading ability, and writing ability.

title: Class Schedule and Attendance
content: Classes meet according to the published term schedule. Students should join five minutes before class begins and use their registered name. Parents should notify the teacher or school office about planned absences. Repeated lateness or absence may affect learning progress.

title: Online Classroom Expectations
content: Students should attend from a quiet, safe space with a working device, camera, microphone, and reliable internet connection. They should be respectful, keep unrelated apps closed, raise a hand before speaking, and follow the teacher's directions. A parent or guardian should help younger learners join the session.

title: Materials and Homework
content: Teachers share digital worksheets, reading material, and practice activities through the approved school channel. Students should keep a Tamil notebook and complete assigned work before the next lesson. Parents are encouraged to support regular practice without completing the work for the student.

title: Progress Assessment
content: Progress is assessed through participation, homework, reading activities, writing tasks, speaking practice, and periodic checks. Teachers provide feedback and may recommend additional practice or a level change when it best supports the student's learning.

title: Fees and Payments
content: Term fees, payment methods, and due dates are communicated before enrollment or renewal. Families should make payments by the stated deadline. Questions about invoices, receipts, payment plans, or eligible refunds should be sent to the school office.

title: Communication with Families
content: The school uses its official email, parent portal, or approved messaging channel for announcements, schedules, materials, and progress updates. Parents should keep their contact details current and contact the teacher or school office respectfully for academic or administrative questions.

title: Privacy and Recording
content: Student information, class links, and learning materials must be kept private. Parents and students may not share class links or record lessons unless the school has given written permission. Any school-provided recordings are for enrolled students' learning only.

title: Technical Support
content: For login, video, audio, or material-access problems, families should first check their internet connection, device settings, and the joining instructions. If the issue continues, they should contact school support with the student's name, class level, and a brief description of the problem.
